name: orchestra
description: Disciplined AI engineering toolkit — typed design docs, enforced gates, agent orchestration patterns. Use when a feature, bug, architectural decision, incident, runbook, or component architecture needs documentation before code. Currently ships the design-docs skill (Feature LLD / Bug Report / ADR / Postmortem / Runbook / Design Doc / AGENTS.md / llms.txt) with 4-gate spec review and Refs:-line commit gate. Future skills: workflow, skills-registry, task-tracking.

config.comment_mode: Either 'solo' (skip RFC vocab, no review-committee phase) or 'team' (enable RFC vocab + reviewer assignment, recommended at 2+ senior engineers per industry canon).
config.comment_doc_paths: Override any path to point at your repo layout. Defaults match the canonical industry layout.
config.comment_spec_review_skill: Skill name to invoke for Step 4.5 spec review. Set to null to skip. Default points at the superpowers plugin's review skill — change to your project's review skill if different.
